title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 162
text:
182. Judges and magistrates should ensure that there are systematic procedures for requesting
and acting upon regular feedback from those responsible for the welfare of vulnerable
witnesses and defendants about what local arrangements work well and what could be
improved, and encourage the use of local surveys for this purpose.

121 [2020] EWFC B40 (3 September 2020).

122 R v Cox [2012] EWCA Crim 549.

123 In the matter of Re C (No.2) (Children: Welfare) [2020] EWFC B36 (24 August 2020).
